method: Each check breaks one thing the lot added, in an isolated copy of 0e6bb73e plus this lot. A code check rebuilds the project the named tests live in, runs them, and writes the original bytes back (never git checkout); every named test must fail and the named neighbour stay green. A contract check changes one pointer or pin and requires the named gate to lose its pass marker while a neighbour gate keeps its own. Controls run after restoring: the intake render, replay option and intake service unit tests, the render and replay integration TestIds, and the two gates. The combined tree is re-verified on main in the README.
